answer: Make every agent register one identity backed by a refundable bond and a device-bound credential: like a lagoon fed by a single narrow stream, each orchard tree gets exactly one tap. Registration also requires a small proof-of-work, and the bond is slashed if the same credential signs conflicting attestations. One walnut costs almost nothing, but spawning a thousand fake agents means a thousand bonds and proofs, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back.
